claims.statement: Two host services make real model calls — `@zhangj1164/dsh-memo` and `@zhangj1164/dsh-github-issue` — and both resolve the route of every call in the same three-level order: the caller's request, then the service's own `Config`, then the deployment's `agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()`; no level carries a hardcoded provider or model.

`dsh-github-issue` resolves the route through `firstNonBlank`, so a blank or whitespace-only `provider`/`model` counts as absent and cannot shadow the next level (`Config`, then `agentDefaultModel`); only when all three levels are blank does `resolveRoute` return `undefined`.

`dsh-memo`'s `resolveRoute` chains the same three levels with `??`, so a literal empty string survives resolution as a route value; what turns that into a failure is the pre-flight check inside `streamLlmText`, which returns `NO_MODEL_ROUTE` before any `llm.stream` call is made.

When nothing resolves a route, `dsh-github-issue` returns the distinct business code `route-missing` and attempts no model call, while recording a telemetry failure under DSH's `NO_MODEL_ROUTE` code with `featureCodeRef: github-issue:<action>` so a suite-wide analysis groups both packages under one code.

`streamLlmText` terminates in exactly five failure shapes plus one success: `LLM_UNAVAILABLE` when the `llm` service is not mounted, `NO_MODEL_ROUTE` when the resolved provider or model is empty, the preserved DSH `code`/`message`/optional `status` when the stream's `finish` reason is `error` or `aborted`, `LLM_STREAM_THREW` when an exception escapes DSH normalization, `EMPTY_RESPONSE` when the stream ends normally with zero text, and `{ ok: true, text }` otherwise.

`EMPTY_RESPONSE` is not invented locally: both helpers import `EMPTY_RESPONSE_CODE` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`, the code DSH itself reserves for a successful call that produced no text, which is what keeps "the model answered nothing" from sharing a code with "the route does not work".

Preserving the facts exists to keep two defects distinguishable: a route that is unregistered or missing (`NO_ADAPTER`, `NO_MODEL_ROUTE`) is a routing or configuration defect whose owner is the deployment, while `EMPTY_RESPONSE` is a model that answered with nothing; reporting the first as the second sent users hunting for a model problem in a call that never reached a model.

`dsh-github-issue` wraps a preserved failure in a `llm-failure` business failure whose message reads `model call to provider "<provider>" model "<model>" failed: <code>: <message>`, and records a telemetry failure carrying the preserved `code` and `message` plus `provider`, `model`, and `status` metadata.

`dsh-memo` uses the same message prefix, and additionally lifts `failureCode`, `provider`, `model`, and optional `status` to the top level of its `llm-failure` failure object, so callers can branch on the machine-routing code without parsing the message string.

Both services attach `provider` and `model` to successful telemetry events too, not only to failures, because a record that named the route only when it broke can never answer whether changing the route fixed it.

`memo/listModels` builds its catalog only from `llm.listProviders()`, i.e. registered routes, so dormant providers an adapter merely declared are excluded; each registered provider's models come from an independent `llm.listModels(id)` call, and a catalog query that throws leaves an `error` on that provider alone while the others keep their models.

`MemoListModelsResult` has no failure variant: an unmounted `llm` service, a `listProviders()` that throws, and a registry with zero registered providers all return `ok: true` with an empty `providers` list plus a `catalogError`, and are recorded as `llm-unavailable` / `providers-threw` / `no-provider`, because a deployment without a model route must still be able to open the memo board.

The route catalog is produced on the host only and read by the browser over the `memo/listModels` Remote call; the browser never hardcodes a route, `selectModel` accepts only a provider the host just reported with both halves non-empty, and a remembered choice is dropped when its provider disappears from a readable registry yet kept when `catalogError` marks the registry as unknown rather than empty.

`streamLlmText` is duplicated rather than shared: one structurally identical copy lives in each host package because `dsh-memo` depends on `dsh-github-issue` and not the other way round, with the stated extraction point being a third consumer — so any change to failure preservation must be applied to both copies or one service silently regresses to reporting an empty response.

`memo/analyzeLogs` passes memo's own resolved route as `provider`/`model` to `githubIssue.generateReport`, so the report-generation call follows memo's route rather than the github-issue service `Config`, and a failure there collapses into a `github-issue-failure` business failure carrying the underlying message.

Every contract on this page is pinned by focused tests: github-issue covers the three-level precedence, blank-as-absent, and `route-missing` with an empty `llm.requests` list; memo covers `NO_ADAPTER`, `MISSING_CREDENTIAL` with `status`, `EMPTY_RESPONSE`, catalog aggregation and its degradations; the controller covers refusing to pin an unreported provider and keeping a choice while the registry is unreadable.
两个包都逐半解析路由：`provider` 与 `model` 各自独立沿「请求 → Config → agentDefaultModel」取第一个合格值，因此一条可用路由可以由不同来源拼成，而不可用的唯一判据是其中一个半区为空。

`provider`/`model`/`status` 这几个遥测元数据键跨包构成契约：`dsh-telemetry` 的 `routeFromMetadata` 用白名单只复制这三个键、要求 `provider` 与 `model` 都是非空字符串、`status` 是有限数，缺一半即视为「未记录路由」而不产出 `TelemetryFailureGroup.route`，因此改名或只写一半会让 issue 报告静默丢掉路由而没有任何编译或服务测试失败。
「未记录」与「没有路由」被严格区分：`TelemetryFailureGroup.route` 的缺席只表示那些事件没记路由，memo 在路由解析为空时显式写入 `provider: ''`/`model: ''` 以区别于老事件的省略键，而 github-issue 的 `route-missing` 事件因为无路由可记而不带路由元数据。
`memo/listModels` 的三条降级路径（未挂 `llm`、`listProviders()` 抛出、零注册 provider）把遥测事件记为 `result: 'failure'` 并在元数据里带 `reason`，而业务结果仍是 `ok: true`，所以日志分析里 `memo:listModels` 会出现失败组而看板照常可用。
`memo/analyzeLogs` 传给 `githubIssue.generateReport` 的路由可能含空串的一半，github-issue 的 `firstNonBlank` 会把这一半当作未提供而回落到自己的 `Config` 与部署默认，因此该链路只在 memo 解析成功的那一半上跟随 memo 的路由，也不会因为 memo 没路由就直接返回 `route-missing`。

`LLM_UNAVAILABLE` 的可达性由挂载声明决定：`dsh-github-issue` 声明 `static inject = ['llm']`，没有 `llm` 就不会激活，该分支对它只是防御；`dsh-memo` 的 `inject` 不含 `llm`（按 `ctx.get('llm')` 可选读取），因此未挂 `llm` 是 memo 真实可达的部署状态，且这种部署仍必须能打开备忘看板。
